text.en: Claude Code 2.1.326, dated 16 November 2026, warns at startup about incomplete --allowedTools, --disallowedTools or --tools entries and explains when managed-mcp.json stops MCP servers loading, according to its changelog.
text.es: Claude Code 2.1.326, del 16 de noviembre de 2026, avisa al arrancar de entradas incompletas en --allowedTools, --disallowedTools o --tools y explica cuándo managed-mcp.json detiene la carga de servidores MCP, según su changelog.
text.ca: Claude Code 2.1.326, del 16 de novembre de 2026, avisa en arrencar d'entrades incompletes a --allowedTools, --disallowedTools o --tools i explica quan managed-mcp.json atura la càrrega de servidors MCP, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Kiro CLI 3.4.0, dated 16 November 2026, lets a PreToolUse hook in V3 sessions change a tool call's inputs or reply to its permission prompt, according to its changelog.
text.es: Kiro CLI 3.4.0, del 16 de noviembre de 2026, permite que un hook PreToolUse en sesiones V3 cambie las entradas de una llamada a herramienta o responda a su petición de permiso, según su changelog.
text.ca: Kiro CLI 3.4.0, del 16 de novembre de 2026, permet que un hook PreToolUse en sessions V3 canviï les entrades d'una crida a una eina o respongui a la seva petició de permís, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Devin release notes dated 16 November 2026 say Devin now stores each member's linked accounts in Slack, Microsoft Teams, git providers, Jira, Linear and Pylon to match people to them.
text.es: Las notas de versión de Devin del 16 de noviembre de 2026 dicen que Devin ahora guarda las cuentas vinculadas de cada miembro en Slack, Microsoft Teams, proveedores git, Jira, Linear y Pylon para relacionar a las personas.
text.ca: Les notes de versió de Devin del 16 de novembre de 2026 diuen que Devin ara desa els comptes vinculats de cada membre a Slack, Microsoft Teams, proveïdors git, Jira, Linear i Pylon per relacionar les persones.

text.en: CVE-2026-115563, NVD, 16 November 2026: MCP Python SDK OAuth clients from 1.9.1 until 1.30.0 and 2.2.0 may send credentials to an authorization server an untrusted MCP server picks, per NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-115563, NVD, 16 de noviembre de 2026: los clientes OAuth del MCP Python SDK de 1.9.1 hasta 1.30.0 y 2.2.0 pueden enviar credenciales a un servidor de autorización que elige un servidor MCP no fiable, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-115563, NVD, 16 de novembre de 2026: els clients OAuth del MCP Python SDK de 1.9.1 fins a 1.30.0 i 2.2.0 poden enviar credencials a un servidor d'autorització que tria un servidor MCP no fiable, segons NVD.

text.en: MAL-2026-20011, in OSV on 16 November 2026, lists the npm package mem0-mcp-server as malicious code, according to OSV.
text.es: MAL-2026-20011, en OSV el 16 de noviembre de 2026, registra el paquete npm mem0-mcp-server como código malicioso, según OSV.
text.ca: MAL-2026-20011, a OSV el 16 de novembre de 2026, registra el paquet npm mem0-mcp-server com a codi maliciós, segons OSV.

held.text_en: Kiro Enterprise, in its changelog dated 16 November 2026, lets administrators stream each LLM request and completed tool call as a real-time OpenTelemetry event to their observability tools.

CVE-2026-68934 and GHSA-jq3q-62jc-fqq9, dated 16 November 2026: code-review-mcp-server before 1.5.3 runs folderPath and baseBranch parameters through a shell, allowing command injection, according to NVD.
MAL-2026-20009, in OSV on 16 November 2026, lists the npm package @shadowdu/memos-mcp as malicious code, according to OSV.
MAL-2026-20008, in OSV on 16 November 2026, lists the npm package @shadowdqj/image-mcp as malicious code, according to OSV.
CVE-2026-126681, in NVD on 16 November 2026: AWS Labs Timestream for InfluxDB MCP Server before 0.0.19 can disclose its InfluxDB API token to a crafted endpoint, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-126816, in NVD on 16 November 2026: AWS Pricing MCP Server before 1.0.31 can write report output outside its intended directory via path traversal, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-129235, in NVD on 16 November 2026: the download_file tool of kubeshark mcp from 53.1.0 until 53.4.0 writes to caller-chosen paths, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-129236, in NVD on 16 November 2026: the start_kubeshark tool of kubeshark mcp from 53.1.0 until 53.4.0 lets a pod_regex value be parsed as a Helm override, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-123142, in NVD on 17 November 2026: GitLab CE/EE let an MCP-scoped OAuth token change issue and merge request state, including merging, in several version ranges, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-129875, in NVD on 16 November 2026: REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 lets low-privileged users recover the administrator password hash through its MCP QueryRecords tool, according to NVD.
